name: AdventureTime
changes: Peer transport Auto now prefers DanNet, then E3, then EQBC (was E3-first, which picked E3 on every box carrying MQ2Mono).
DanNet echo mute (localecho/commandecho off) now runs at load before the first relay instead of waiting for the 5s tick retry; first retry is 1s.
Settings > Peer transport: a saved E3/EQBC/DanNet selection now re-detects at load and is actually used (was overridden by Auto's earlier pick).
A selected-but-missing transport logs once and backs off 15s instead of re-detecting (and on DanNet, /plugin-loading with a 750ms delay) on every relay.
Settings hint text updated to describe the Auto order.
notes: Peer transport is saved in the shared per-machine settings file; a group split across PCs needs it set on each.
On E3 transport, /e3bcga may include the sender - untested. Verify with '/e3bcga /echo hi'; switch to /e3bcg if it echoes locally.
